```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

# Packages (install if missing)
required_pkgs <- c(
  "flexdashboard","shiny","MASS","dplyr","ggplot2","skimr","caret","glmnet",
  "patchwork","randomForest","corrplot","DT","scales","tibble"
)
for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg)
}

library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(MASS)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(skimr)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(patchwork)
library(randomForest)
library(corrplot)
library(DT)
library(scales)
library(tibble)

set.seed(42)

# --- Metrics helpers ---
rmse <- function(actual, pred) sqrt(mean((actual - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae  <- function(actual, pred) mean(abs(actual - pred), na.rm = TRUE)
r2   <- function(actual, pred) {
  # guard against zero variance
  if (sd(pred, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 || sd(actual, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  cor(actual, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2
}

# --- Data load ---
data("Boston", package = "MASS")
boston.df <- Boston

# Train/test split (stratified)
set.seed(123)
idx <- createDataPartition(boston.df$medv, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_df <- boston.df[idx, ]
test_df  <- boston.df[-idx, ]

x_train_raw <- train_df %>% select(-medv)
x_test_raw  <- test_df %>% select(-medv)
y_train <- train_df$medv
y_test  <- test_df$medv

# Preprocess for glmnet only (center/scale)
preproc <- preProcess(x_train_raw, method = c("center", "scale"))
x_train <- predict(preproc, x_train_raw)
x_test  <- predict(preproc, x_test_raw)

# CV settings
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 10, repeats = 3)

# --- Fit models once (dashboard startup) ---
# Baseline
baseline_pred <- rep(mean(y_train), length(y_test))

# Linear Regression
lm_fit <- train(medv ~ ., data = train_df, method = "lm", trControl = ctrl)
lm_pred <- predict(lm_fit, newdata = test_df)

# Elastic Net
grid_glmnet <- expand.grid(
  alpha  = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
  lambda = 10^seq(-3, 1, length.out = 40)
)
glmnet_fit <- train(
  x = as.matrix(x_train),
  y = y_train,
  method = "glmnet",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneGrid = grid_glmnet
)
glmnet_pred <- predict(glmnet_fit, newdata = as.matrix(x_test))

# Random Forest
set.seed(42)
rf_fit <- train(
  medv ~ ., data = train_df,
  method = "rf",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneLength = 8
)
rf_pred <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_df)

# --- Consolidated test metrics ---
results_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Model = "Baseline (Train Mean)", RMSE = rmse(y_test, baseline_pred), MAE = mae(y_test, baseline_pred), R2 = r2(y_test, baseline_pred)),
  tibble(Model = "Linear Regression",     RMSE = rmse(y_test, lm_pred),      MAE = mae(y_test, lm_pred),      R2 = r2(y_test, lm_pred)),
  tibble(Model = "Elastic Net (glmnet)",  RMSE = rmse(y_test, glmnet_pred),  MAE = mae(y_test, glmnet_pred),  R2 = r2(y_test, glmnet_pred)),
  tibble(Model = "Random Forest",         RMSE = rmse(y_test, rf_pred),      MAE = mae(y_test, rf_pred),      R2 = r2(y_test, rf_pred))
) %>% arrange(RMSE)

best_model_name <- results_tbl$Model[1]

# Common plot df for best-model evaluation
best_pred <- switch(
  best_model_name,
  "Baseline (Train Mean)" = baseline_pred,
  "Linear Regression" = lm_pred,
  "Elastic Net (glmnet)" = glmnet_pred,
  "Random Forest" = rf_pred,
  baseline_pred
)

plot_df_best <- tibble(
  actual = y_test,
  predicted = as.numeric(best_pred)
) %>%
  mutate(error = actual - predicted, abs_error = abs(error))

# RF importance
rf_imp_df <- {
  imp <- randomForest::importance(rf_fit$finalModel)
  tibble(Feature = rownames(imp), Importance = imp[, 1]) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance))
}

# Elastic net coefficients
glmnet_coef_df <- {
  bt <- glmnet_fit$bestTune
  cm <- coef(glmnet_fit$finalModel, s = bt$lambda)
  tibble(
    term = rownames(as.matrix(cm)),
    estimate = as.numeric(as.matrix(cm))
  ) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))
}

# For scoring inputs
predictor_names <- names(train_df %>% select(-medv))
med_defaults <- sapply(train_df[predictor_names], median)

# Robust scoring function
score_medv <- function(newdata, model_name = best_model_name) {
  stopifnot(all(predictor_names %in% names(newdata)))
  newdata <- newdata %>% select(all_of(predictor_names))

  pred <- switch(
    model_name,
    "Linear Regression" = predict(lm_fit, newdata = newdata),
    "Elastic Net (glmnet)" = {
      x_new <- predict(preproc, newdata)
      predict(glmnet_fit, newdata = as.matrix(x_new))
    },
    "Random Forest" = predict(rf_fit, newdata = newdata),
    rep(mean(y_train), nrow(newdata))
  )

  as.numeric(pred)
}
```
